role: Process-wide, lock-protected, in-memory bounded (32) cache of AnalysisSummaryGenerator summaries keyed by session UUID with an optional fingerprint so stale summaries are not served.
types: AnalysisSummaryCache: final class (Sendable) — FIFO-by-store-time bounded summary cache
toplevel: static let shared; private static maxEntries 32; state lock initialised with empty State.

flags.text: docs/API_REFERENCE.md calls it 'LRU 32 entries', but get() does not refresh `order`; eviction is by least recently STORED (as the file's own doc says), so a frequently read entry can be evicted first.

units.does: Private no-op initializer for the singleton.

Hashes NarrativeLanguage.isEnglish, app locale id, session recoveryScore, frozenReadiness, tags, analysisResult date/rmssd/meanHR, sleep start/end ms, sleep minutes, respiratory rate and SpO2 into an Int fingerprint (per-process Hasher seed).

flags.text: Doc says the fingerprint changes whenever the generated summary could change, but ContextBuilder generates the cached summary from recentSessions, baselineStats and liveLoadSnapshot, none of which are hashed; a summary cached in the morning keeps being served to the assistant after a workout changes the live training load or new nights change the trend/baseline.

units.does: Under the lock: moves id to the end of `order`, stores summary and fingerprint (default 0), then evicts from the front of `order` until ≤32 entries.

branches.effect: pop oldest-stored id and drop its entry+fingerprint; loop until within bound; false: done

units.does: Returns the cached summary for id regardless of fingerprint, or nil.

flags.text: No caller in app or tests: grep for `get(forSessionId:` finds only the fingerprint-matching overload in ContextBuilder.swift:184 and CitationQuickView.swift:16.

units.does: Returns the cached summary only when a fingerprint is stored for id and equals the given one; otherwise nil.

branches.cond: no stored fingerprint for id, or it differs
branches.effect: return nil (caller regenerates); else return entries[id]

units.does: Removes the entry, fingerprint and order slot for sessionId.

flags.text: invalidate(sessionId:) has no caller anywhere in the repo (app or tests); staleness relies solely on fingerprints.
